verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships AI features (the MCP server, the built-in agent, AI Decisioning and Ad Studio), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, policy or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. A community note that data stays in the customer's warehouse describes storage architecture, which is a different control from AI training and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
